topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Finding my college application essay used as an example was a quiet surprise. The words, now set in front of others, once held a personal echo, a dialogue between my thoughts and the admissions committee. It’s curious, seeing private intentions laid bare, crafted to convey more than just qualifications, but a semblance of self. Yet, there’s a certain pride in the exposure, an unspoken validation. The essay, after all, was more than a requirement; it was a statement. Now, it serves, perhaps inspiring, or at least guiding, those treading the same path. In the silence that follows such discoveries, there’s room for both reflection and a measured step forward.
